const CATEGORY_FALLBACKS = {
  proteins:
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1604503468506-a8da13d82791?w=400&q=80",
  vegetables:
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512621776951-a57141f2eefd?w=400&q=80",

  drinks:
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1610970881699-44a5587cabec?w=400&q=80",
};

const DEFAULT_IMAGE =
  "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1490645935967-10de6ba17061?w=400&q=80";

/**
 * Returns the best matching image URL for a product.
 * Priority: exact product name match → category fallback → global default
 *
 * @param {Object} product - Product object with at least { productName, category, imageUrl? }
 * @returns {string} Image URL
 */
export function getImage(product) {
  // 1. If the product already has an imageUrl stored (e.g. admin-uploaded), use it
  if (product.imageUrl) return product.imageUrl;

  // 2. Try matching by normalised product name
  const key = (product.productName || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (PRODUCT_IMAGE_MAP[key]) return PRODUCT_IMAGE_MAP[key];

  // 3. Partial / keyword match for future products you haven't listed yet
  for (const [mapKey, url] of Object.entries(PRODUCT_IMAGE_MAP)) {
    if (key.includes(mapKey) || mapKey.includes(key)) return url;
  }

  // 4. Fall back to category image
  const cat = (product.category || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (CATEGORY_FALLBACKS[cat]) return CATEGORY_FALLBACKS[cat];

  // 5. Ultimate default
  return DEFAULT_IMAGE;
}
